facts.statement: Napaisaurus is an iguanodontian ornithopod dinosaur found in the Early Cretaceous Xinlong Formation of Guangxi, China.
facts.quote: Napaisaurus is a genus of iguanodontian ornithopod dinosaur from the Early Cretaceous Xinlong Formation of Guangxi, China.

facts.statement: The only known species of Napaisaurus is Napaisaurus guangxiensis.
facts.quote: The type and only species is N. guangxiensis.

facts.statement: The holotype of Napaisaurus, consisting of a right ilium and ischium, was discovered in 2020.
facts.quote: The Napaisaurus holotype, FS-20-007–008, consists of a right ilium and ischium discovered in 2020.

facts.statement: Ji and Zhang described Napaisaurus as a new genus and species in 2022 based on diagnostic characters in the fossil material.
facts.quote: A mix of diagonstic characters observed in the material led Ji & Zhang to describe it as a new genus and species in 2022.

facts.statement: The genus name Napaisaurus combines the type locality, the Napai Basin, with the Greek word for lizard.
facts.quote: The generic name, "Napaisaurus", combines a reference to the type locality in the Napai Basin with the Greek word "saurus", meaning "lizard".

facts.statement: The species name guangxiensis refers to the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region where the fossils were found.
facts.quote: The specific name, "guangxiensis", references Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region where the fossils were discovered.

facts.statement: Napaisaurus is the first basal iguanodontian dinosaur to be named from southern China.
facts.quote: Napaisaurus represents the first basal iguanodontian to be named from southern China.

facts.statement: Napaisaurus belongs to the parent group Styracosterna.
Napaisaurus is classified within the class Ornithischia.
Napaisaurus lived during the Aptian stage, between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Researchers suggest that the Napaisaurus holotype should be compared with the undescribed ischium and ilium of Sirindhorna in future studies.
rejected.quote: They suggested that the Napaisaurus holotype should be compared to the undescribed ischium and ilium of Sirindhorna in future research.
